Thanks — jumping on this now. Drafted the acceptance checklist and token budget; pasted the key items below and attached the slide with example targets.

Acceptance checklist (draft):
- Functional: API integration (token exchange + client auth) by day 5
- Perf: p50 <= 220ms, p95 <= 480ms on our test harness for 512-token requests
- Accuracy: sample evaluation set BLEU-like pass rate >= 78% (customer prompts)
- Cost: measured token burn <= $X/day baseline (see token budget table)
- Security: data-in-transit TLS1.3, no persistent storage of PII (handled by app-side pseudonymization)

Attached: (attachment: byteworks-30d-eval-timeline.gslides - updated slide with perf targets)

I also added a short failover rollback plan in the MAP doc: if perf degrades >20% over a 24h window, we revert to model vX and escalate to engineering.

Will push the GDoc update in ~30m.
